$comment: Per-product layer allow-lists ($layer-steward's contract). Every LAYER_STATE_REGISTRY id must appear in every product. reason is required for disabled entries and must be editorial or legal, never 'unused'. Disable, don't delete — disabled layers stay in the tree so upstream merges stay clean.
